feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: State of U.S. democracy reaches new low, report finds
entry.summary: A new global democracy report finds the U.S. at its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years it has been measured.

entry.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
entry.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

entry.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to stop attacks on energy sites
entry.summary: In the face of soaring diesel prices, President Trump claims Ukraine and Russia have agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy sites.

entry.title: Air pollution spiked after the Trump administration stopped embassy monitoring
entry.summary: In 2025, the Trump administration ended a long-running program to collect air pollution data at U.S. embassies. A new study suggests that led to a 24-33% increase in local pollution levels.

entry.title: NATO jets shoot down a drone in Lithuanian airspace
entry.summary: The incident came less than a day after NATO leaders pledged that strikes close to the alliance's territory would drive the trans-Atlantic organization to increase support for Kyiv.

entry.title: Anthropic co-founder says slowing AI is a 'collective action problem'
entry.summary: Anthropic co-founder Jack Clark discusses growing concerns about artificial intelligence, recent warning signs and what he says companies should do to reduce the risks.

entry.title: Israel is 'dismantling Palestinian life' says Israeli human rights group
entry.summary: One of the country's leading human rights organizations says Israel is dismantling all aspects of Palestinian life at a breakneck rate. The group has extensively documented what it says are the mechanisms Israel has used to "ethnically cleanse" the West Bank of Palestinians.

entry.title: The producer of Fleabag and Baby Reindeer's tip for finding a hit? Don't look for one
entry.summary: Theatre producer Francesca Moody has a remarkable record of spotting shows that go on to have wide success. At the Edinburgh Fringe festival, she told NPR about what she looks for in a performance.

entry.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
entry.summary: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

entry.title: Beijing hits back at Anthropic CEO's call to curb China's AI development
entry.summary: China's Foreign Ministry called the Anthropic CEO's warning about the dangers of Chinese-developed AI "fearmongering," as the Chinese and U.S. leaders prepare to meet in Washington later this month.
